name: Wakefield Autumn 2023
information: ## IMPORTANT: We have had a venue change for this competition. Please make a note of the **new** venue details of this competition. ### As this is a smaller venue, we highly encourage competitors to reduce the number of guests they are bringing. Guests of competitors will be allowed in the venue at any time, however spectators will only be permitted to attend after 1:00pm on both days. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
